info: The verb changes according to the gender and number of the subject, rather than having a different past-tense form for each person. For example, я бежал means “I ran” when the speaker is male, while я бежала is used when the speaker is female. The ending therefore tells you the gender and number, while the pronoun я tells you that the subject is “I.” Russian verbs also have perfective and imperfective forms, which determine how the past action is viewed.
